page.overview:
What is Attack on the ancestral retreat?

During the Shu-Torun War forces of the rebellious ore-dukes attacked Queen Trios and her Imperial allies in the ancestral retreat of the Shu-Torun royalty. The Sith Lord Darth Vader, leader of the Imperial forces, single handedly boarded the dukes' vessel the Lava Leviathan and sank it.
